why:
I moved from Germany to Saudi Arabia when I was thirteen, and for a long time football was the one thing that made sense. Not the game itself: the numbers behind it. I kept a notebook of power rankings built from nothing but watching and counting.

Later I was told that the thing I actually cared about, data and programming, did not count as real, so I built it myself instead. ballknowledge is the same idea: a place where the numbers get to count. It started as one question, can a model beat "always pick the home team", and it grew into quizzes, a model you can try to out-call, and now basketball.

Everything here is meant to be honest. If the data is missing, I say so instead of guessing.
